W: Rough walls. Scratched everywhere, the same words: "AGAIN. AGAIN."
B: A duelling banner, torn in half.
k: A candle, burning low. Somebody still tends it.

objects.name: The Drill Sergeant
lines: Nobody finds me down here. Come back when you can hold a sword, and we'll see what you're made of.

answer: THE HOLE BELOW THE YARD, MAGGOT. Where fighters come to learn the bits nobody claps for.
Footwork. Breathing. Getting up. Mostly getting up.

questions.ask: What do you think of the Warden?
answer: Never met him. Only what you've told me. Thirty strikes and stands there like a wall? Good wall. Bad soldier.
A wall doesn't win. A wall waits. Somebody trained him to stand. Nobody trained him to move.

questions.ask: Do you ever talk at a normal volume?
answer: * He leans in, very close, and whispers. "This is my angry volume." You preferred the shouting.
